messages:
netbot: ALERT: Partial customer impact in apac-1 starting ~07:12 UTC. Symptoms: elevated 429s and intermittent degradations for large-batch realtime requests routed through egress-gateway-3. Live incident: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2723456789 :rotating_light:

aisha: seeing egress queue saturation on egress-gateway-3. tail latency up and upstream returning 429s. looks correlated with an egress-shedding policy change deployed 06:45 UTC. sample log:
```
WARN egress-gw: shed request due to egress_capacity_exceeded tenant=tenant-xyz
ERR http: upstream returned 429 for 10.5.2.7
```

tom: disabling the new shedding policy on a canary cohort now. command: `egressctl apply --region apac-1 --policy shedding_v2 --action disable --percent 10`

celia: mitigation steps in flight:
- paused shedding_v2 rollout (deployed 06:45 UTC)
- disabled policy on 10% canary -> observed immediate drop in 429s on those hosts
- shifted a portion of traffic to alternate egress cluster (apac-fallback) to relieve pressure
- temporarily increased egress gateway concurrency and buffer limits by +20%
- added a per-tenant soft-cap to prevent single noisy tenants from exhausting egress bandwidth

aisha: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/egress/egress-overview?from=now-30m&to=now p95/p99 trending down after canary rollback. 429s reduced from ~6% -> ~1.2% on rolled-back nodes.

oncall: collecting request IDs and traces for affected tenants, archiving to s3://incidents/2723456789/traces. please avoid recycling canary hosts until artifacts captured.

support: drafting customer note: "We observed transient request rejections (429) in apac-1 due to a recently deployed egress policy. We paused the deployment and applied mitigations; service stability is improving. More details at https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2723456789" Will queue for enterprise 1:1 outreach.

tom: performing staged rollback to 100% if metrics remain stable for 10m. plan for a careful reintroduce with tighter rate-limits per-tenant and additional acceptance checks (chartered canary with synthetic load).

celia: post-incident actions being created:
- ENG-14500: add preflight egress capacity test with synthetic tenants before policy rollout
- OPS-14501: add automatic rollback trigger if egress 429s >0.5% baseline over 2m
- ENG-14502: implement heavier telemetry around per-tenant egress utilization and a noisy-tenant mitigation throttle

aisha: status: fallback routing absorbing residual load, p99 and 429s continue to fall. will keep open 30m after stable baseline and then send final customer update.

oncall: if you see recurrence, tag `@oncall` and attach traces to the incident artifacts.

netbot: Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2723456789 (runbook + artifacts). Broadcast to #customers-facing scheduled in 10m pending stability. :white_check_mark:
